group_label: Extra missions (Nadesico B, Ra Cailum, White Fang...)

glossary.ja: オーガニック・プレート
glossary.role: The disc-shaped plates Orphan produces, from which Antibodies are revived.

glossary.ja: ジョナサン・グレーン
glossary.role: Reclaimer ace of Orphan; pilots Jonathan Grand Cher, later Jonathan Baronz; Yuu's rival and the son of Novis Noah's captain Anoa McCormick
glossary.personality: Arrogant, aggressive and taunting, full of resentment toward Yuu and his own mother. Loyal to Baron Maximilian.

glossary.role: Computer voice prefix (alarm messages in katakana-robot speech).
Londo Bell flagship battleship (Bright Noa's ship) in CCA.
Orphan-loyal Antibody piloted by Reclaimers (generic grunt unit)

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: TV: operator/science officer of the Nadesico. PoD: Lieutenant Commander, captain of the Nadesico B ("Electronic Fairy")
glossary.personality: Deadpan, cool, blunt child prodigy (catchphrase "bunch of fools"); slowly warms to the crew

glossary.role: Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture - Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: NS-955B Nadesico B, second-generation Nadesico-class battleship of the UESF captained by Ruri

Emperor ruling the Pentagona World from Sveto on Gastogal; supreme commander of the Poseidal Army. The Poseidal on the throne is actually Mian Qu Ha Ussher, a puppet of the true Poseidal (Amandara Kamandara). In ACE2 'Poseidal' is the pilot of the Aug.
glossary.personality: Regal, cold and imperious ruler who controls others (e.g. Quwasan) through the bio-relation system; her memories are themselves manipulated, and she finally turns against Amandara.

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture - Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: Earth's unified space force after the war; operates the Nadesico B

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness

glossary.note: Op 01 uses 'unit' for mecha in general, 'machine' when the speaker is the developer

report.translator_summary: Translated all 80 rows of xa_02, covering the climax of Extra Mission m6006 (Jonathan Glenn vs Yuu Isami, discovery of the Organic Plate, hazard/underwater callouts) and the start of Extra Mission m6007 (cooperation between Nadesico B under Captain Ruri Hoshino and the Ra Cailum under Captain Bright Noa against Giganos forces).
uncertainties: Lines m6006#47-48 contain color tokens surrounding empty/newline text in original JP; preserved exact sequence #c[FF0000]\n#c. Generic callout voices (underwater speed drops, sonar proximity, unexploded ordnance) varied naturally across pilot archetypes.
